# Module 14 — functional interfaces and date-time

Allowed: modules 1–13, plus lambda expressions, method references, `Predicate`, `Function`, `Consumer`, `Supplier`, `LocalDate`, `LocalTime`, `LocalDateTime`, `Duration`, `Period`, and `DateTimeFormatter`.

A `Comparator` may now be a lambda. Do not suggest or require: the Stream API, threads, file I/O, or web APIs.

Do not ask to replace a lambda or a date calculation with a stream.
